reviews.text: My babygirl just turned 9 and has spent the majority of her life in a shelter. She’s a special girl who thrives on slow introductions, patience, and a lot of love. I’m so grateful to have found The Dog Dude in Bushwick! Bertlee took his time to get to know my girl, and to introduce her to two of his fellow Dog Dudes before they took over the reigns. I have peace of mind while I’m at work because I know she’s in good hands. Thanks Dudes!

Based on other reviews the Dog Dude was who I called first when moving to my new neighborhood. I’m particular about who takes care of my boy Ernie, but after meeting the owner (Bert, I kid you not), I knew my pup was in good hands.

They send awesome little updates with pictures, give him fresh water, and have taken care of little mishaps that have happened while I’m away - both dog related and non dog related!

They are the best. Polite; take great care of my pup, and communicate extremely well. Highly recommend!

I live in Bushwick and have a small pitbull who does not like other dogs (and who I am very overprotective of). In the past, I have found it hard to find reliable dog walkers. Bertlee and his Dog Dude team (Brian, Andy) have been awesome! 👏 I definitely recommend them. They are consistent and careful, as well as clear communicators. I recently had Brian stay in my home and watch my dog for 2 weeks while I was on vacation. ❤️ It was really nice to go away and not worry about my dog. THANK YOU TEAM! 🐶
Bertlee and his team are so wonderful and attentive to my three legged pup and her unique needs. Bertlee goes above and beyond to accommodate his clients and I recommend him wholeheartedly.

I could not recommend The Dog Dude more for your BedStuy dog walking needs! Bertlee and his group of workers are top notch walkers! My favorite part about working with this group is the friendly/safe environment they provide for your dogs, as well as the timely updates they send with pictures of your dogs adventures! If you need a dog walker reach out to Bertlee at The Dog Dude, they are the best!!

Bertlee and his team are the best! They worked to make sure my baby girl was comfortable and she always looks so happy and excited when she’s out with the dog dudes! I’m so grateful they’re based in bushwick because I know wait times won’t be long. Baby girl loves the treats and I love the service so it’s a great time all around! 💞
Absolutely amazing service. Professional, friendly, and reliable. Our dogs love them.

Highly recommend Bertlee and his team for Bushwick dog walking services. They are very kind and also are naturals with dogs. I am never worried when my golden retriever Zeus is in their hands. Zeus is always very excited to see Bertlee or Andy come through the door! Doing pack walks with them (with my consent) has helped improve Zeus's sociability with other dogs.  Communication is excellent and each walk is documented with photos.

This is a great, easy, reliable dog walking business! I live in Bushwick and have my dog walked about 2-3 times a week, often adding last minute walks that they are happy to accommodate. My dog is old and can be aggressive with other dogs and they have done great catering to her needs.
Bertlee, Quinn, Kei, and their team are amazing! Always there to help take care of my dog Teddy when my schedule changes last-minute, and Teddy absolutely loves them. Thanks for all you do!
Bertlee and the crew of dog dudes are the best! They are local to us in bushwick and they take such good care of our pup. 10/10 recommend if you need amazing dog care!

I am so beyond grateful to have Bertlee and Kei in our lives - they take such amazing care of my two dogs, and are extremely professional and considerate. Since moving to Bushwick a few years ago, the Dog Dude has given me such peace of mind and are extremely accommodating. Cannot recommend enough!

Highly recommend Bertlee and the other dog dudes to all those in Bushwick looking for a reliable and fun dog walker! Bertlee walked my 6 month old foster pup while I was at work, and I felt much better knowing she was in the care of someone I could trust. He organized a meet and greet beforehand, then I just scheduled all the walks online. After the walk, he writes a post and sends over several pictures to show the adventures they went on! I would look forward to reading the update every day and loved knowing that my dog was safe and happy while I was away.

We couldn’t recommend Bertlee more!! We’re located in Bushwick and have been using his services since August almost weekly. Sammy has really warmed up to him. He is pretty anxious with strangers, especially men, so this is a big deal. He was very patient and took his time training a new walker to take over and they get along great.

We especially appreciate the timely updates through their portal, always with pictures, and the easy scheduling! Thank you Bertlee and team :)

They have been walking my little mini dachshund for a few weeks now and he lovesss his walks with Quinn! As a dog mom, I love the personalized updates I get of each walk. I save every picture and cherish every emoji used. I love how Quinn lets me know how Harry is feeling on his walks. Highly recommend going with The Dog Dude for walks!!

Found Bertleee and his team last minute when I needed a dog walker for a trip. They went out of their way to come to Bed-Stuy and have booked them a few times since. Dependable, reliable, and my dog loves them. Always excited to see them and comes home happy. Highly recommend!

Excellent dog walkers in bushwick! The whole team takes great care of my senior shih tzu. They're thoughtful of her limits during hot/cold weather. They send updates and pictures with each walk. It makes me happy to know she's in good hands and gets to enjoy her afternoon visits with them.
Highly recommend!!  Best dog walkers in Bedstuy/Bushwick and beyond! They are trustworthy, reliable, and flexible!

Bertlee and Quinn have been nothing but great dog walkers. If you are looking for the perfect combination of people who take their job seriously while simultaneously are caring and very nice people to deal with go with this dog walking service. Our dog looks forward to his walks everyday and we feel at ease leaving our dog in their hands with the high quality services they provide.

Hands down the best experience with the Dog Dude in bushwick! Hes an absolute pro with my puppy. Flexible, accommodating and made me feel so at ease while being out of town with regular communication of pictures and updates, homemade treats and tlc for my little girl. Leaving my pup always puts me on edge but the dog dude made it easy and fun!

I can’t say enough great things about the Dog Dudes! From day one, they’ve been reliable, professional, and genuinely caring. It gives me such peace of mind knowing my dog is not only getting exercise but also attention, love, and thoughtful care every time.

They’re always punctual, communicate clearly, and go above and beyond to make sure my dog is happy and comfortable.

If you’re looking for someone trustworthy who truly treats your dog like their own, I highly recommend them. Absolutely five stars!

Bertlee is the man! The top choice for dog walking services in and around Bushwick.

I rescued my dog Keiko last year and he was shortly thereafter diagnosed with heartworm. I started using Bertlee for walks when I wasn't able to bring Keiko to work. He provided excellent communication and thoughtful updates about their walks while helping me maintain his treatment targets. Bertlee was able to provide much needed piece of mind when I needed extra help during Keiko's treatment. Bertlee and his walkers we able to accommodate my requests and we're always quick with scheduling turnaround and communication.
Highly recommend! We’re in Bushwick and have two big pit bulls, and they handled them confidently and with care. Always on time twice a day, super reliable, and our dogs love them.
We have no record of this individual as a client. This review does not appear to be associated with our services!
Everyone has been so great and patient with my dog! I couldn’t ask for more reliable and caring people to walk and pet sit Rico in Bushwick. Highly recommend!!

100% recommend these kind folks! Bertlee and Kei took such good care of Badger while I was away for Thanksgiving. They came highly recommended from my building. He got plenty of walks around Bushwick, and got lots of loving attention. Kei gave me updates throughout, which was a joy to see. If you're going out of town or just need some walks in, reach out to The Dog Dude!

This team is incredible and trustworthy! They watched after my guy in Bushwick for 10 days giving me daily pictures and updates on him, taking him to the park, and playing with other dogs (with my permission) I cannot recommend them enough!

Bertlee and his team of walkers are fantastic! They’re so great with my pup, patient with her, and clearly love dogs. They’re super communicative and reliable, and my go to for walks and dog sitting. I always get photos and I can tell she just loves spending time with them. I had trouble finding a consistent walker in Bushwick, but the Dog Dude is top notch!!

As a fellow dog walker and trainer here in Bushwick, I’ve personally used Bertlee to walk my own dog, Ace, and also to help out with some of my clients when I’m too busy. When I say he’s the best, I truly mean it! He’s professional, reliable, and trustworthy, super upbeat and down-to-earth, and you can tell he genuinely loves dogs and takes pride in his work.

My pup adores him (and the treats he brings!) and always comes home happy and tired after their walks. His boarding and dog sitting services are safe, dependable, and provide complete peace of mind. Communication is excellent updates, photos, and flexible scheduling make everything stress-free.

If you’re looking for loving, attentive care and structured walks or overnight boarding in Bushwick, I highly recommend Bertlee. He’s the kind of responsible, caring, and experienced dog walker every owner hopes to find.

I love this service! Best dog walker in Bushwick! My dog loves to go on his daily walks with Bertlee. He is attentive and very personal. I feel at ease when my pup is with Bertlee and his team. Try them out, you won’t regret it!
Thanks for walking my pup. Quick, easy, trustworthy! The best dog walkers in Bushwick!

Bertlee and his crew are the best! Our dog, Roscoe, is obsessed with him and Andy. We have full confidence and trust in them taking care of Roscoe and being in our home when we aren’t there. They are communicative and always let us know if there is a slight change in anything. Couldn’t recommend them enough!

Bertlee and Saria were part of the team that took care of Charley! They were extremely communicative and reliable. They took good care of Charley, refreshed his water bowl after every walk and provided him treats and lots of love. Definitely recommend them for your dog caring needs

bertlee has been walking my puppy Romeo for a few months now and i couldn’t think of a better person to handle my high energy and sometimes stubborn pup! most reliable dog walker in bedstuy!! Romeo love’s his walks and it’s always nice getting the updates after!

Bertlee and the Dog Dudes are the best and incredible with my pup. She's a lot to handle, and they are really kind and understanding. They've also been there on short notice and the scheduling is incredibly easy. For anyone on the fence, definitely reach out! Bertlee's initial consult was extremely thorough and you can truly tell that every one of the walkers absolutely loves being with dogs. After every walk I get an update and the cutest pictures. With work from home ending, the Dog Dudes have been a massive help.

Bertlee and the guys have been walking our staffy Mugzy maybe a year and we couldn’t be happier. Mugzy is a rescue who can be apprehensive with new people and this team did a great job getting him to open up. He goes crazy for them now. Super communicative and easy to work with. Plus they take the best pictures of my baby AND he gets to wear their hats.

Bertlee has been walking my dog atlas for almost a year now! We are so lucky to have someone so trustworthy and reliable! He’s super flexible and has been great accommodating last minute walks when my schedule changes unexpectedly.

Looking forward to many more walks with Bertlee and his crew!
Bertlee and Brian have been amazing with my bulldogs Aumi and Otto. Would recommend.

Bertlee is reliable, communicative, great with dogs and people, and truly somebody I’m so grateful to have found! He sends very thorough updates including pictures with each walk, cleans my dog’s paws, and refills her water bowl every time he walks her. He’s also very detail oriented, and from the beginning I was impressed with how he wanted to really learn about and get to know my dog and what she needs. He asked good questions, took notes, and has a gentle demeanor. As a result, even my nervous rescue dog who is weary of pretty much all men was really comfortable with him from the first time she met him. Additionally he’s flexible with scheduling and easy to communicate with via text. I really can’t recommend Bertlee enough!

Bertlee and his crew walk our two senior dogs (11, 13) regularly and they're the best. They send pics, wipe paws, refresh water. Very reliable, kind, and clearly love dogs! Our senior dogs have unique needs sometimes including recovering from injury and they took it slow when needed, carried them when needed.. rain or shine they show up. Walks are ideal for our dogs who used to go to day care but can no longer tolerate too much puppy power and cooties. Dogs are k.o.'d and satiated when they arrive, smelling of sun and adventure. Thank you so much Bertlee, Andy! Highly recommend!!! Pics are of our doggies and their little friends....

Bertlee took amazing care of Pretzels, our puppy, and was super communicative throughout Pretzels' stay. He sent many photo updates daily. Pretzels had many walks and little neighborhood adventures. 10/10 would recommend Bertlee for any pet sitting needs.
This guys is the absolute best , he took the outmost care for my puppy brooklyn , hes is def the best in the game and such an amazing genuine caring dude and believe me , your doggy is in great hands
Bertlee and his team are awesome. Always willing to help out in a pinch, detailed walk reports, and very reasonable pricing. Can’t recommend enough.

Bertlee, Brian, & Jeff all take wonderful care of my girl! I'm a dog handler myself and am very picky with who I leave Luna with because of my job. I'm so happy to have found a company I can trust with my baby. She's loved endlessly (& spoiled) by her dudes <3

we have used this dog walking service for our 18yr Minpin and Bertlee is truly the best. He has incredible leadership, calm and confident approach and kindness above all. My dog who usually takes a while to warm up to people immediately felt comfortable and at ease w his leadership and energy. Highly recommend them for anyone in the Bushwick area

I cannot recommend Bertlee and his team more!  I have a hard headed pittie who can be picky with who he lets walk him and he was instantly comfortable with Bertlee.  He also put weeks into training a backup, Brain which was much appreciated.

The whole team is fantastic! They're courteous, and attentive and I'd book them 10x over.
Bertlee has been walking my dog Millie for 2yrs abs she absolutely adores him and Brian. The team is super attentive, loving and I know when I leave my girl she is in good hands. 10/10 recommend :)

We were looking for a dog sitter for our dog before a trip we took this fall. We have tried rover in the past, and we did not have a good experience with Rover. Our dog can be reactive when feeling unsafe, and he needed special care from someone we trust. We decided to give Bertlee a try!  He started with walking Tazz 1-2x per week, and Tazz quickly loved seeing him! It’s nice to receive pictures and an update on how the walks go. Bertlee also took care of Tazz for nearly 2 weeks. I felt so confident and reassured that Tazz was well taken care of! Bertlee does such an awesome job with respecting Tazz’s boundaries and giving him the attention he needs! Although I work from home, we want to continue to have Bertlee take our dog for walks every once in a while because it makes Tazz so happy! Bertlee is Tazz approved!!! 🐶
